text_en: "The leaden word knows count—excess shall fall"

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-047 · 限额印章
归属意志：第 XII 层 · 祷文引擎本体
异常概述：收容前状态下，异文令任一铸字坊的日产能锁定为其设计产能的 ██%。受影响设施内铅字在达到特定铸印次数后失去铭刻响应，键徒动作正常但无法产生有效祷击。D-████ 级人员在尝试超额铸印时出现 [数据删除] 症状。
收容残余：引擎压制下，异文效应衰减为对单次登塔任务的铭分产出施加上限约束。
附注：第 ██ 铸字坊天花板发现未授权的蜡封印记，内容为早期崇拜时代的配额祷文。印记无法移除。
——「节制乃铸者之德，贪溢致炉火反噬」
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-047 · Quota Seal
Manifesting Will: Layer XII · The Litany Engine Primary
Anomaly Summary: In uncontained state, the anomaly enforced daily production caps at ██% of design capacity across affected foundries. Lead type lost inscriptive responsiveness after reaching specific impression counts, with keybound personnel exhibiting normal motor function but producing no effective litany-strikes. D-████ class subjects attempting quota violation developed [DATA EXPUNGED] symptoms.
Containment Residue: Under Engine suppression, anomalous effects reduced to inscription score limitations during individual ascent attempts.
Addendum: Unauthorized wax sigil discovered on Foundry ██ ceiling, bearing quota liturgy from early Worship Era. Sigil proves non-removable.
——「Temperance marks the founder's virtue; excess invites the furnace's wrath」
